human_check: This record is the first time the port reached a frame. Everything before the frame is behind it: 538 shader compiles with no refusal in that stretch - including the input-attachment shaders R10 unblocked, whose SpvCapabilityInputAttachment warnings now end in compile done: result=0 - and then the engine finished start-up and began recording its first command buffer. What stops it is a recording refusal: vkEndCommandBuffer returns -13, and the blocker is that the refusal block is EMPTY. 'ERROR-OUT BEGIN' is followed by two blank lines, so nothing names the command the driver refused. That is R4's rule again - a refusal must name its field - and it is why this is R11 and not a port bug: the port cannot act on an unnamed refusal, and the driver's own recording refusals do carry messages (ps5vk_cmd_buffer_refuse takes one). No frame was presented, because the refusal is in recording, before the submit. The must_not_contain needles are the previous two stops (a refused pipeline, an ACO abort), so a regression to either is visible.
